{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p="specs/001-transactions/plan.md"
s=open(p).read()

# 1) Summary: extend for milestone 2
old_summary=s[s.index("## Summary"):s.index("## Technical Context")]
new_summary="""## Summary

Add a new additive public type `TaggedCache(maxsize)` in a new module
`src/cachetools/tagged.py`. It wraps the existing `cachetools.LRUCache`
for bounded LRU storage and layers tag bookkeeping on top so entries can
be invalidated by tag (single tag or many, any/all). Every stored value
is deep-copied on input and on retrieval; `get` misses raise `KeyError`;
tag input is validated strictly (finite iterable of strings, deduplicated,
generators consumed once, bare strings and non-string entries rejected
with `ValueError` before any state change); `maxsize` must be a positive
integer excluding booleans; `resize` changes capacity safely (shrink
evicts LRU, grow evicts nothing, failure preserves all state); the
`maxsize` property reports the current capacity. All existing
cachetools APIs remain untouched (no edits to existing modules).

"""
s=s.replace(old_summary,new_summary,1)

# 2) Phase 0 pointer: add R8-R10
old_p0=s[s.index("## Phase 0"):s.index("## Phase 1")]
new_p0="""## Phase 0 — Research (see research.md)

Resolved items: (1) reuse `LRUCache` via its public mapping protocol
rather than subclassing or poking at name-mangled internals; (2) tag
index design (`key -> frozenset`, `tag -> set(keys)`); (3) validation
ordering (validate tags before touching state); (4) `maxsize` validation
rule; (5) Claim-A open item disposition (put-refresh adopted); (6)
`invalidate_many` any/all set semantics with empty-removes-zero (R04);
(7) `resize` mechanics: popitem-based shrink + capacity update, rebuild
rejected (R05); (8) generator tags consumed exactly once (R06). Details
and alternatives in [research.md](research.md).

"""
s=s.replace(old_p0,new_p0,1)

# 3) Phase 1 pointer: mention milestone-2 additions
old_p1=s[s.index("## Phase 1"):s.index("## Complexity Tracking")]
new_p1="""## Phase 1 — Design (see data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md)

- Entities and invariants (incl. resize transitions): [data-model.md](data-model.md)
- Public API contract (incl. `invalidate_many`, `resize`, `maxsize`
  property): [contracts/tagged-cache-api.md](contracts/tagged-cache-api.md)
- Validation scenarios (incl. milestone-2 boundaries): [quickstart.md](quickstart.md)

"""
s=s.replace(old_p1,new_p1,1)

# 4) Technical Context: append milestone-2 observed facts
anchor="- Upstream tests: `tests/test_*.py` (13 files) must remain unmodified."
add=(anchor+"\n"
"- `Cache` exposes a read-only `maxsize` property (observed, lines ~148-152)"
"\n  backed by the name-mangled `self.__maxsize` set in `Cache.__init__` — a"
"\n  runtime capacity change therefore either updates that attribute or"
"\n  rebuilds the LRU cache (see research.md R7)."
"\n- `LRUCache.popitem()` is a public method returning the LRU `(key, value)`"
"\n  pair (observed, lines 224-231) — usable for shrink-eviction without"
"\n  reaching into `__order`."
"\n- `LRUCache.__iter__` inherits `Cache.__iter__` (plain dict, insertion"
"\n  order — NOT recency order, observed lines 126-128 + 208) — recency"
"\n  order is only observable via `popitem()`/eviction, so any reordering"
"\n  logic must use `popitem()`, not iteration.")
s=s.replace(anchor,add,1)
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("plan.md updated, lines:", s.count(chr(10)))
PYEOF"}
